values: Estimates = USD × rate × (1 + reserve). Reserve is a planning allowance, not a quoted tax rate.
Yellow cells are editable. Use Status and My notes to track your choice. Filter the header row.
Recommended: Sparked Host Advanced, 1 GB, $2/month. Choose monthly billing with no optional add-ons.
Fit: this small Node 22 Discord bot needs an ongoing connection and no local database. Capacity is estimated from the code, not a live benchmark.
Prices exclude unselected extras. Free, trial and conditional plans have different limits. The reserve is an estimate and does not enforce a spending cap.
1 GB RAM, 0.75 CPU, 15 GB storage, 1 bot and Node 22. Shared hosting. US, Paris or Sydney only. Backups and code fixes cost extra. Choose monthly billing with no optional add-ons.
1 GB RAM, Git support and seven-day backups. Verify Node 22 availability in the panel before buying. North America / Europe locations.
1 CPU, 1 GB RAM, 25 GB disk, 1,000 GiB transfer. Singapore available. Maintain the server yourself. Backups, extra resources and transfer overages cost extra.
512 MB RAM and 0.5 CPU. Managed background worker with Git deployment. Hobby workspace includes 5 GB outbound, then $0.15/GB. Use a worker, not a free web service.
$5 monthly minimum includes $5 usage. Additional use is metered. Set a $10 compute hard limit and $8 alert. The bot stops at the limit. Omit paid Agent features. PHP estimate is the minimum.

Two limited free services, no advertised expiry. HOLD: status update on 6 Nov reports investigation of a 30 Oct security incident involving decrypted secrets. Revisit after resolution. Verify card requirements.
No hosting subscription. Electricity and internet still cost money. Sleep, shutdowns, power cuts or connection loss take the bot offline. Do not buy new hardware just for this option.
Workload and cost assumption based on the supplied bot code. No provider subscription.

Compute can be free: one e2-micro, 1 GB RAM, selected US regions, 30 GB standard disk and 1 GB egress. Typical public IPv4 adds about $3.65/month ($0.005/hour × 730 hours). Limits and other resources can add charges.
Eligible new accounts may receive up to $200 credits. Ends after six months or when credits run out. The free plan closes unless upgraded. Continuing on a paid plan costs money.
$1 monthly credit after the initial $5 / 30-day trial. Usage is metered. The allowance may not cover a continuously running Discord bot. Suitable for testing until measured usage proves otherwise.
Sleeps after 15 minutes without qualifying inbound traffic. Discord gateway traffic cannot wake it like a web request. No free background workers. Does not fit this bot's ongoing connection.
